stem: A golfer hit a golf ball from a tee box that is 6 yards above the ground. The graph shows the height in yards of the golf ball above the ground as a quadratic function of x, the horizontal distance in yards of the golf ball from the tee box. What is the domain of the function for this situation?
visual_elements: Graph of a parabolic path of a golf ball starting at (0, 6), peaking at (110, 36), and landing at (230, 0). Axes labeled x (horizontal distance) and y (height).
